Since we’ve had it our productivity jumped so much that we shifted some of our plans 6 months ahead and will ship them at DevDay instead of mid next year.

Happy building!

GPT-6 Astra is now available to all Pro, Enterprise, and Business Premium users in Work/Codex, and is available in the API.

We will start rollout to Plus and Business users next.

Thank you for the patience.

first, sorry for the messy rollout.

second, when we screw up, we try to make it right.

third, we should be able to begin broad rollout to API customers and chatgpt subscribers in the near future. as usual we will start with pro subscribers.

Alongside the launch of GPT-6 Astra, we're committing $1 billion to subsidize Daybreak access and frontier capabilities to help frontline defenders protect essential services and critical infrastructure.

2. mid-turn steering — you can inject messages into the model while it's reasoning to steer it in a different direction (incl. tool outputs for the async function calls)
3. change reasoning effort without breaking cache
